ubo_and_aml_profiling.statutory_law_governance: Anti-Money Laundering Law of the People's Republic of China (promulgated 2006, amended 2018); People's Bank of China / State Administration for Market Regulation Order No. 3 on the Administration of Beneficial Owner Information, effective 1 November 2024; Measures for Anti-Money Laundering and Anti-Terrorist Financing Administration of Financial Institutions, effective 1 November 2024; Company Law of the People's Republic of China (2023 revision, effective 1 July 2024); Law of the People's Republic of China on Tax Administration and the Collection of Taxes and implementation regulations.

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Certificate of Incorporation (or equivalent constitutional document) of each non-PRC shareholder and ultimate parent
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Competent corporate registry or companies registrar in the country of origin of the foreign investor
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Parallel Exclusive Path A (Hague Apostille state): notarize at the foreign notary, obtain Apostille from the competent national or regional authority, and submit with a certified PRC translation. Parallel Exclusive Path B (non-member state): notarize, authenticate at the foreign ministry of foreign affairs, and obtain consular legalization at the Embassy/Consulate of the People's Republic of China; then submit with certified PRC translation. Paths A and B are mutually exclusive and must never be combined in sequence.

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Certificate of Good Standing or Certificate of Existence of each foreign corporate shareholder
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Companies registrar, secretary of state, or equivalent authority of the source jurisdiction
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Parallel Exclusive Path A (Hague Apostille state): Apostille after notarization if required; certified PRC translation; no consular legalization. Parallel Exclusive Path B (non-member state): notarization, foreign ministry authentication, PRC consular legalization; certified PRC translation. Paths A and B are mutually exclusive and must never be combined in sequence.

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Board Resolution and Power of Attorney appointing the Chinese JV formation agent and authorizing signature of registration documents
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Board of directors of each non-PRC shareholder, notarized in the source jurisdiction
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Parallel Exclusive Path A (Hague Apostille state): board resolution notarized, then apostilled by competent authority; certified PRC translation. Parallel Exclusive Path B (non-member state): board resolution notarized, authenticated by the foreign ministry, then legalized by PRC Embassy/Consulate; certified PRC translation. Paths A and B are mutually exclusive and must never be combined in sequence.

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Articles of Association (or Memorandum/Charter) of each non-PRC shareholder
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Company secretary, legal representative, or designated registered agent of the foreign entity
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Parallel Exclusive Path A (Hague Apostille state): notarization if required and Apostille; certified PRC translation. Parallel Exclusive Path B (non-member state): notarization, foreign ministry authentication, PRC consular legalization; certified PRC translation. Paths A and B are mutually exclusive and must never be combined in sequence.

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Bank Reference Letter for the principal foreign shareholder or the JV's intended remitter of registered capital
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Licensed commercial bank holding the foreign investor's account relationship
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Parallel Exclusive Path A (Hague Apostille state): original bank letter on bank letterhead, notarized, apostilled, and accompanied by certified PRC translation. Parallel Exclusive Path B (non-member state): notarized, authenticated by the foreign ministry, legalized by the PRC consulate, and accompanied by certified PRC translation. Paths A and B are mutually exclusive and must never be combined in sequence.

ubo_and_aml_profiling.pep_and_sanctions_screening_protocols: Before formation, before capital contribution, and on every material change of direct or indirect ownership, the JV must screen all shareholders, UBOs, directors, controllers, and authorized agents against the OFAC SDN List, the UN Security Council Consolidated Sanctions List, EU/UK financial sanctions lists, and PRC sanctions and export-control designations administered by the Ministry of Foreign Affairs and the Ministry of Commerce. Any FATF-defined politically exposed person (PEP) must be risk-rated as high, with written senior-management approval, source-of-wealth evidence, and enhanced ongoing monitoring. Domestic screening must also check SAMR administrative penalty records, State Taxation Administration tax non-payment records, judicial enforcement/bankruptcy lists, and registered-offender databases. All screening hits and false-positive rationales must be documented in auditable Chinese and English records with time-stamped evidence.

statutory_name_clearance_protocol.registry_portal_name: SAMR Enterprise Name Self-Declaration System / National Enterprise Registration and Credit Information Publicity Platform, administered by the State Administration for Market Regulation through the municipal counterpart registry of the proposed registered location
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.language_and_transliteration_doctrine: The official legal name of the Sino-Foreign Equity Joint Venture must be stated in simplified Chinese characters. A foreign-language or pinyin name may be used only as a supplementary translation; it cannot replace the Chinese statutory name. The name must follow the four-tier convention: (i) administrative district, (ii) unique distinctive business appellation, (iii) industry or business-scope classification, and (iv) legal-form suffix indicating a limited liability company. Transliteration of foreign trademarks must be a faithful phonetic transliteration, with no similarity to existing registrations and no misleading suggestion of government sponsorship, public institution status, or unlicensed financial activity.
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.extension_and_rejection_appeal_sop: Upon rejection, the applicant shall request a written statement of reasons from the local SAMR registry within five working days. Within sixty days from receipt of the written rejection, the applicant may lodge an administrative reconsideration with the next-higher market regulatory bureau or with SAMR, filing a corrected four-tier name proposal, evidence of trademark rights, written consent of any person whose name is incorporated, and a legal memorandum distinguishing the name from prohibited or sensitive tokens. If the reconsideration is denied, the applicant may initiate an administrative lawsuit in the competent People's Court within six months. During the appeal, a fresh name-reservation application may be filed where the original reservation is about to expire.

registered_office_and_commercial_substan.virtual_office_permissibility: A purely virtual office or commercial mailbox is not acceptable for the planned JV because SAMR, the State Taxation Administration, and commercial banks require a bona fide business premises in the registered municipality. For a tax structuring and transfer pricing consultancy, the local tax bureau will require a lease contract, proof of building ownership or a landlord authorization, stamped rent invoices, and evidence of lawful utility bills; banks will require a site visit and original lease before opening the corporate account. A serviced office with a private office license, occupancy certificate, and actual staff presence can be accepted, but a letterbox or co-working virtual address alone will be rejected by both the tax authority and the bank for VAT invoice issuance and account activation.
registered_office_and_commercial_substan.physical_inspection_likelihood: Inspection checklist: (1) company name signboard at the registered address; (2) original lease, ownership certificate, and rent payment/invoice trail; (3) staff presence and functional office equipment during business hours; (4) accounting books, vouchers, contracts, and statutory filings; (5) issuance ledger for VAT invoices and bank records; (6) UBO/beneficial-owner register. Quantified risk: for a low-risk consultancy with a physical serviced office, annual random inspection probability is approximately 8% to 12%; if the office appears understaffed, has no signboard, or shows a remote-managed mailbox, probability rises to 25% to 30%; upon detection of invoice anomalies or cross-border fee mismatches, targeted on-site inspection probability exceeds 70%.

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: No statutory tariff; prevailing agency incorporation package benchmark RMB 500 to RMB 1,000 if delegated

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Notarization, Hague Apostille or consular legalization of foreign corporate document bundle (5 instruments)
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: Foreign notary; competent Hague Apostille authority; foreign ministry of source country; PRC Embassy or Consulate
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Statutory per-document notarial/apostille tariffs plus PRC consular fee schedule; market benchmark USD 80 to USD 250 per document

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: PRC law firm and local notary public office
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Fixed engagement fee per PRC local bar association billing guidance and notarial fee schedule

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: Ministry of Commerce / National Development and Reform Commission / SAMR / PBOC (official reporting fee eliminated)
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: No government tariff; optional intermediary handling fee of USD 100 to USD 200 if outsourced

incorporation_legal_framework.governing_statute_and_sections: Company Law of the People's Republic of China (2023 Revision, adopted 29 December 2023, effective 1 July 2024), in particular Articles 32, 33, 47, 68 and 70; the Foreign Investment Law of the People's Republic of China (effective 1 January 2020), Articles 3, 6 and 31; and the Regulations of the People's Republic of China on Company Registration (2022 Revision).
incorporation_legal_framework.competent_registry_authority: Enterprise Registration Office of the local Municipal Administration for Market Regulation (SAMR), with online submission through the National Enterprise Credit Information Publicity System and ex-post Foreign Investment Information Report to the Ministry of Commerce (MOFCOM).
incorporation_legal_framework.statutory_filing_instrument: SAMR Form 1: Application for Establishment Registration of a Limited Liability Company, together with the Company's Articles of Association and all statutory attachments.
incorporation_legal_framework.minimum_paid_up_capital_rule: No statutory minimum registered capital and no blocked escrow account requirement for an ISIC 7020 consulting joint venture. Under PRC Company Law Article 47, shareholders must fully pay subscribed capital within five years of incorporation unless the Articles of Association impose an earlier payment schedule. Paid-in capital may be zero at the time of registration, but the subscribed amount must be commercially reasonable for the consulting undertaking and cannot be used artificially to evade creditors.
incorporation_legal_framework.pro_forma_first_board_resolution_en: RESOLUTIONS OF THE FIRST MEETING OF THE BOARD OF DIRECTORS OF [CN_JV_LTD] (THE 'COMPANY'), ADOPTED BY UNANIMOUS WRITTEN CONSENT OF ALL DIRECTORS. 1. Registered Office. RESOLVED, that the registered office of the Company be and is hereby fixed at [Insert Registered Office Address, China (Mainland)] as the statutory domicile for service of process, official correspondence, and statutory record maintenance, and the Chief Executive Officer or Company Secretary is authorized to execute any lease, consent, or filing required to record such office with SAMR. 2. Share Capital Subscription. RESOLVED, that each shareholder's subscription to the registered capital of the Company be and is hereby accepted as set forth in the Articles of Association; the subscribed and paid-in capital shall be contributed in accordance with Article 47 of the PRC Company Law and the Capital Contribution Schedule, in cash or permissible in-kind contributions, and the board shall issue capital contribution verification certificates upon receipt of each tranche. 3. Banking Authorization. RESOLVED, that [Bank Name] at [Branch] is designated as the principal depository bank of the Company, and the Chairman / legal representative together with any two designated signatories shall constitute the authorized signing mandate; the board hereby approves all account opening, inward and outward wire instructions, foreign currency settlement, and electronic banking protocols, subject to the Company's seal policy and two-person approval rule for all disbursements above operational thresholds. 4. Statutory Officers. RESOLVED, that [Name] is appointed as director, chairperson and legal representative of the Company; [Name] is appointed as Chief Executive Officer; [Name] is appointed as supervisor with the statutory powers of oversight and inspection; and [Name] is appointed as Company Secretary and Chief Tax Compliance Officer responsible for ISIC 7020 cross-border tax structuring and transfer pricing filings. 5. Corporate Governance Delegation. RESOLVED, that the Chief Executive Officer is authorized, within the duly approved annual budget, to execute all day-to-day client contracts, employment agreements, service agreements, purchase orders and regulatory filings consistent with these resolutions and the PRC Company Law; matters outside delegated authority shall require a further board resolution. 6. Ratification and Further Actions. RESOLVED, that all prior acts of the incorporators, the legal representative and the founding shareholders in relation to the Company's formation are hereby ratified, and each officer is authorized to prepare, execute, deliver and file every return, form, notice or report necessary to give effect to these resolutions. This resolution is effective as of the date of adoption and shall remain in force until amended or revoked by a subsequent resolution of the board of directors.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Name and Business Scope Pre-Clearance and Foreign Investment Negative List Screening
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Enterprise Name Reservation and Business Scope Screening window, local Municipal Administration for Market Regulation (SAMR), using the SAMR Corporate Name Registration and Online Service Platform; Foreign Investment Negative List screening by NDRC/MOFCOM database.
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Log into the SAMR Corporate Name Registration and Online Service Platform or attend the municipal service hall and submit the proposed Chinese and English company names together with a classified ISIC 7020 business scope drafted as international tax structuring, transfer pricing advisory, and cross-border corporate tax compliance. The application must identify all ultimate shareholders, the JV ownership ratio, and certify that the scope does not appear on the Foreign Investment Negative List. The authority will screen for name conflicts, prohibited occupations, negative-list restrictions and consistency with the applicant's foreign-invested status. Issuance of the Name Reservation Notice is the mandatory gateway for later filing.
required_dossiers: Name reservation application form on the SAMR standard template
Certified passport copy or corporate certificate of each joint venture shareholder
Proposed Articles of Association summary
ISIC 7020 business scope description in English and Chinese
Foreign Investment Negative List self-certification
Power of attorney for the designated filing agent
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the name is rejected for conflict or prohibited wording, select three alternative names and resubmit without additional fee. If the negative-list screening flags the scope, restructure the equity or narrow the business scope before the formal incorporation filing. Any administrative query must be cured with a written clarification and supplementary certificate within five working days.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Execution, Notarization and Apostille of Formation Documents
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: PRC Notary Public Office at the place of signing and the Ministry of Foreign Affairs of the PRC or provincial Foreign Affairs Offices as PRC competent authority under the Hague Apostille Convention (effective 7 November 2023).
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Conduct a closing session in which all shareholders and proposed directors execute the Articles of Association, capital contribution schedule, first board written consent, and lease of registered address. Foreign natural person signatures must be notarized and apostilled in the signatory's home jurisdiction if executed outside PRC; corporate shareholders must provide board resolutions and apostilled certificates. The PRC notary, if applying onshore, will certify Chinese translations of all foreign documents. The legal representative must sign the standard SAMR application before a notary online or offline. The objective is a complete authenticated packet that will survive registry scrutiny.
required_dossiers: Executed and notarized Articles of Association
Shareholders' Agreement and capital contribution schedule
Foreign shareholders' certificates of incorporation, board resolutions and beneficial ownership declarations
Apostille or consular legalization of each foreign-issued corporate record
Registered office lease and landlord's property ownership certificate
Passport or identity copies of all directors, supervisors, legal representative and authorized persons
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the notary identifies a signature discrepancy or missing apostille, cure by executing a corrected signature page before the notary and obtaining a replacement apostille from the home country. No new incorporation number is required until the registration filing, so the correction only extends the authentication phase.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Submission of Establishment Registration to SAMR
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Enterprise Registration Section of the local Municipal Administration for Market Regulation (SAMR), acting through the National Enterprise Credit Information Publicity System or the municipal service hall.
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: File the complete Form 1 Application for Establishment Registration of a Company with the approved name reservation number, notarized Articles of Association, list of shareholders, board members, legal representative and supervisor, capital contribution formalities, and proof of registered office as a single electronic dossier. The SAMR examiner will verify the joint venture's legal representative and supervisor, confirm the board composition, and check that the business scope is coherent with ISIC 7020. The secretariat must respond to any electronic query within the statutory working-day period and, upon approval, the SAMR system will produce the Business License and Unified Social Credit Code.
required_dossiers: Form 1 Establishment Application signed by the legal representative
Name Reservation Notice
Notarized Articles of Association in Chinese translation
List of shareholders and subscribed/paid-in capital schedule
Directors, supervisor and legal representative appointment letters and identity documents
Registered address proof consisting of lease and title deed
Authorization of the filing agent and agent identity proof
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the application is suspended for missing negative-list confirmation, upload a corrective note and a written no-restriction explanation. If the registry requires revised capital or scope wording, adopt a supplementary shareholders' resolution and resubmit the amended form. A conditional refusal may be cured by severing the offending business scope into a wholly domestic entity.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Post-Incorporation Banking, Taxation, Social Insurance and Seal Registration
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Local branch of the designated bank, State Taxation Administration (STA) municipal tax service office, Ministry of Human Resources and Social Security, Public Security Bureau for corporate seal filing, and the MOFCOM integrated foreign investment information reporting portal.
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: After receiving the Company's Business License and Unified Social Credit Code, open a bank settlement account and submit capital contribution payments to the account, then complete tax registration through the STA Filing by One Visit system, enroll in social insurance and housing fund, and obtain statutory company seal, financial seal, invoice seal and legal representative seal with police-filed impressions. This step also requires filing the Foreign Investment Information Report with the Ministry of Commerce through the integrated online platform within 30 days.
required_dossiers: Business License original and copies
Unified Social Credit Code certificate
Legal representative identity card and authorization letter
Articles of Association with stamp
Seal carving application and police filing forms
Bank account opening application and AML/KYC forms
Foreign Investment Information Report form
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If bank KYC delays occur, provide the ownership chart, source-of-funds declaration and board banking resolution. If tax registration fails due to synchronization errors, use the electronic tax bureau pre-filing and amend after data matching. If the MOFCOM report is rejected, refile after correcting the legal representative and unified social credit code.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Statutory Records, First Board Resolution Filing and Economic Substance Readiness
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Company Secretary and local SAMR enterprise file division, together with the STA local tax services directorate for tax health checks.
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Hold and minute the First Board of Directors Meeting, execute the pro-forma first board resolution on share capital, banking, registered office and officers; file the executed resolution in the Company's statutory records at the registered office and publish any mandatory information on the National Credit System. Update beneficial ownership and corporate governance registers and, because the scope is ISIC 7020, position the economic substance files, transfer pricing policy, and bank-rating documentation before cross-border invoices are issued. The company secretary shall retain the minute book and registers available for inspection by authorities.
required_dossiers: Minute book and executed first board resolution
Register of directors, supervisors and senior officers
Shareholder register and capital contribution verification certificates
Registered office record and corporate seal custody log
AML risk-tier assessment and economic substance workbook
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If inspection reveals missing sealed pages or signature pages, reissue the minutes with retroactive authorization and obtain original director signatures. If the tax administration requests financial records, reconcile the capital contribution ledger with the bank statement and submit an explanation through the online tax service portal.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.competent_industrial_authority: Not Applicable - ISIC 7020 comprises non-industrial consulting services; no industrial licensing board or specialized municipal industrial agency has jurisdiction.
industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.operating_license_title: Not Applicable - no industrial, manufacturing, assembly, chemical or warehousing operating license is triggered by the registered business scope; the only statutory authority arising from incorporation is the SAMR Business License already issued, and the tax registration is handled under the State Taxation Administration.

environmental_impact_assessment_eia.classification_tier: Not Applicable - pure office-based consultancy; no EIA category under the PRC Environmental Impact Assessment Law is triggered.
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.discharge_and_emissions_standards: Not Applicable - the activity generates zero process wastewater, zero point-source VOC emissions and no hazardous waste; office waste is collected under municipal requirements, and any general environmental obligations are limited to tenancy-level solid waste disposal.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.civil_defense_and_occupational_clearance: Not Applicable for industrial fire permits, structural load inspections or workplace chemicals licensing; the leased office must nevertheless maintain the building's fire acceptance certificate, basic fire extinguishers, emergency evacuation signage and landlord-provided building safety compliance under the Fire Protection Law of the PRC and the PRC Work Safety Law.

national_tax_registration_infrastructure.competent_tax_authority: State Taxation Administration of the People's Republic of China (STA); administered locally by tax service branches; online electronic portal: National Electronic Taxpayer Service Platform (e-Tax, accessible at etax.chinatax.gov.cn). VAT-specific clearance is handled through the STA VAT Invoice Integrated Service Platform.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.tax_id_procurement_sop: For the onshore Sino-Foreign Equity Joint Venture, the sole statutory tax identifier is the Uniform Social Credit Code (USCC), issued by the State Administration for Market Regulation on the business license. The USCC is automatically shared with the STA under the 'one certificate, one code' reform, completing taxpayer registration ex officio. The local tax bureau then classifies the entity for VAT (small-scale or general taxpayer), opens tax registration records, sets electronic invoice quotas, and links the basic tax deposit bank account. The legal representative or authorized agent must authenticate identity through the national e-Tax platform and download the electronic taxpayer certificate. A foreign non-resident enterprise without a permanent establishment in China that supplies taxable services to or derives China-source income from a Chinese counterparty must separately register through the competent tax authority for non-resident tax withholding/contract registration and must obtain a China tax identification (in the SAFE/STA contract filing system) before the first payment; this registration is coordinated with the domestic payer's withholding obligations.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.statutory_election_mechanisms: None; the PRC system has no check-the-box election. The only material elections are the VAT small-scale taxpayer's election to become a general taxpayer before the compulsory threshold, and, where a non-resident enterprise cannot accurately calculate its taxable income, an election to apply the deemed profit rate method for Enterprise Income Tax withholding.

indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.indirect_tax_system_name: Value-Added Tax (VAT) under the PRC VAT system; taxable supply of tax/advisory services is classified under services with the standard services rate of 6% (a reduced levy applies to small-scale taxpayers).
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.statutory_registration_threshold_local_c: VAT registration is mandatory for all PRC-established entities from incorporation through the USCC-based one-stop registration; compulsory general taxpayer registration is imposed when annual taxable turnover exceeds RMB 5,000,000, unless the taxpayer elects general status earlier. Below RMB 5,000,000 a taxpayer may remain a small-scale VAT taxpayer.
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.electronic_invoicing_and_clearance_manda: The STA mandates issuance through the fully digitalized electronic invoice (e-invoice) system for most taxpayers; invoices are generated in the taxpayer's tax digital account, transmitted in real time to the STA's Golden Tax Phase IV system, and validated with a fiscal invoice number and encrypted digital stamp before delivery. Traditional paper Special VAT Invoices require tax-control equipment and encrypted reporting. No-offset / invoice matching and anti-fraud risk control are automated through e-invoice data, cargo/value/flow cross-checks, and real-time e-invoice integration.

export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.zero_rating_eligibility: Goods qualify for 0% VAT export zero-rating if they are sold to a non-resident, physically leave China, are cleared by China Customs as export, and the export proceeds are repatriated and verified. Services qualify for 0% zero-rating only if the service is named in the STA's cross-border zero-rated services catalogue (e.g., international transport, certain R&D, design, software, and offshore financial services). ISIC 7020 tax-structuring and management-consulting services provided to overseas recipients are generally treated as VAT-exempt (not zero-rated) when the service is consumed wholly outside China; the JV must verify the latest STA catalogue and obtain an offshore service contract, foreign-recipient documentation, and foreign-currency payment evidence before relying on any preferential treatment.
mandatory_customs_documentation_bundle: Customs Export Declaration (China Customs electronic export manifest/declaration, with customs release endorsement)
Bill of Lading / Airway Bill or multimodal transport document evidencing export from China
Inward Remittance Certificate or SAFE foreign-exchange collection/receipt record evidencing actual repatriation of export proceeds
Foreign Trade Operator Registration / Customs Registration Certificate for exporters
For cross-border services: offshore service agreement, foreign recipient business-license or tax-identification evidence, service delivery verification, and overseas payment receipt
export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.audit_scrutiny_and_clawback_penalties: If export zero-rating or exemption is claimed without complete customs documents, without verifiable foreign-exchange repatriation, or on the basis of false documentation, the STA will claw back the zero-rated treatment, assess output VAT at the applicable standard rate, collect late-payment surcharge of 0.05% per day on the unpaid tax, and impose administrative penalties of 50% to 500% of the evaded tax under the Law on Administration of Tax Collection. Fraudulent export-tax-rebate filings additionally attract criminal liability under Article 204 of the Criminal Law, including imprisonment and criminal fines. SAFE may suspend the exporter's trade FX verification status where repatriation deadlines are breached, and tax authorities will re-open prior refunds.

fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.central_bank_authority: People's Bank of China (PBOC) acting through the State Administration of Foreign Exchange (SAFE)
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.currency_convertibility_assessment: China maintains a managed floating exchange-rate regime and a system that is substantially convertible on the current account but tightly controlled on the capital account. The RMB can be freely settled and paid for genuine trade in goods and services, advisory fees, dividend distributions, interest, royalties, and ordinary operational expenses, subject to bank-based documentary screening under SAFE regulations. Capital-account transactions such as foreign direct investment, equity injection, intra-group loans, and cross-border restructuring are not freely convertible and require SAFE registration or approval, a designated domestic bank, and a valid foreign-exchange capital account. For a Sino-foreign equity joint venture, profit and dividend remittance to the foreign investor is permitted only after completion of the annual statutory audit, payment or clearance of enterprise income tax and withholding tax, issuance of a tax payment certificate by the State Taxation Administration, and submission of the audited financial statements, a board resolution approving the dividend, and the required SAFE reporting forms. Funds converted from the capital account enter a special RMB settlement account and may be used only for the stated operating purposes in the SAFE application; reinvestment of those RMB funds into other projects or securities is prohibited unless separately approved. Therefore, the treasury must treat the current account as operationally convertible but must plan all capital movements as regulated events with documentary evidence, purpose codes, and prescribed time windows.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.export_proceeds_surrender_rules: China does not currently enforce a fixed mandatory surrender percentage; exporters may retain up to 100% of eligible foreign-currency export proceeds in an onshore current-account foreign-exchange account or may convert any portion to RMB at the market rate. The statutory duty is that goods-export receipts must be repatriated into the onshore banking system or a SAFE-approved offshore account and reported through the cross-border trade monitoring platform, generally no later than 180 days after the related customs export declaration unless an extension is filed and accepted. If SAFE invokes balance-of-payments stress measures, temporary conversion quotas or mandatory settlement ratios may be reintroduced for specific categories of receipts.

tier1_domestic_commercial_banks.bank_name: Industrial and Commercial Bank of China Limited
tier1_domestic_commercial_banks.account_class: FDI Capital Foreign Exchange Account plus RMB Basic Settlement Account
Basic Operational Currency Account and FDI Capital Foreign Exchange Account
RMB Basic Deposit Account and Capital Contribution Foreign Exchange Account
Capital Foreign Exchange Account and Operational RMB Account

corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.fintech_emi_cross_border_viability: Onshore fintech EMIs are not viable as principal treasury or clearing providers in mainland China. Electronic money institutions in China do not enjoy a licensed corporate-banking charter, cannot access CNAPS or SAFE-regulated foreign-exchange settlement, and are legally barred from establishing the statutory RMB basic deposit account and FDI capital account required for a Sino-foreign equity joint venture. Offshore digital EMIs may support ancillary wallet operations and card payments outside China but cannot clear funds into the JV's onshore tax, payroll, or dividend-repatriation pipeline. The JV must maintain all primary liquidity and FX settlement at a licensed domestic tier-1 commercial bank.
corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.physical_presence_and_kyc_interview_mand: Physical in-branch appearance of the legal representative is mandatory for opening the RMB basic deposit account and the FDI capital foreign-exchange account of a Sino-foreign equity joint venture in mainland China. Remote consular proxy opening is not accepted under PBOC account-opening rules. A non-resident director who is not the legal representative may act under a notarized and legalized power of attorney, but the legal representative or a properly registered onshore manager must attend the KYC interview in person with the company seal, original business license, SAFE registration documents, and passport or PRC identity card.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Ultimate beneficial ownership ambiguity through nominee shareholders or an opaque offshore intermediate holding chain
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: A complete ownership-chain dossier containing certified corporate registers and certificates of incorporation for every holding layer, a notarized UBO declaration, passport or national ID copies of all beneficial owners, a source-of-wealth affidavit, a no-nominee undertaking signed by the JV shareholders, and, if a trust is present, the trust deed and trustee letter.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Inbound FDI capital injection lacking a clear SAFE registration or presenting a third-party payer on the incoming SWIFT wire
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: SAFE foreign-exchange registration certificate or FDI payment filing reference, the equity subscription agreement, executed JV contract, board resolution approving capital contribution, a source-of-funds bank reference letter proving the ordering account belongs to the named foreign investor, and a capital verification report from a licensed PRC CPA after funds land.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Management consultancy and cross-border tax structuring activity flagged as a potential vehicle for circular payments, artificial profit stripping, or tax evasion
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Detailed engagement agreements, time sheets and job-cost reports, professional deliverables, evidence of staff payroll and headcount, valid accounting or tax-advisory licences, Golden Tax System VAT invoices, and transfer-pricing master file and local file demonstrating economic substance and arm's-length fee levels.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Adverse media or sanctions hits against the foreign investor, directors, or counterparties, especially jurisdictions associated with high money-laundering risk
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: A third-party sanctions and PEP screening report from a recognized international provider, negative-news legal research, written jurisdiction-risk rationale, passport or government-issued licence copies, and a parent-company undertaking confirming that no blocked-party funds are being used in the JV.

cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.inbound_capital_injection_routing: The foreign investor must wire funds from its own corporate bank account to the JV's designated capital foreign-exchange account at an approved domestic bank using SWIFT MT103. The wire should state the JV name and SAFE FDI registration number, and the remittance should be categorized under the PRC foreign-exchange purpose code for FDI equity contribution. Upon receipt, the bank verifies the payment against SAFE records, credits the capital FX account, and permits the JV to convert the funds into RMB in a special settlement account. A licensed Chinese CPA must then issue a capital verification report. The RMB proceeds may be used only for the JV's stated operating purposes and cannot be used for securities investments, entrusted loans, or speculative FX trading.
cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.outbound_trade_disbursements: For outbound trade and service settlements, the JV should use CIPS and domestic RMB clearing for local expenditures, and SWIFT MT103 for ordinary cross-border service fees, SWIFT MT700 commercial letters of credit for goods transactions, and documentary collections for seller-financed trade flows. Every outbound remittance requires the underlying service or sale contract, commercial invoice, SAFE foreign-exchange payment application, beneficial-ownership declaration, and proof of tax deduction or a valid foreign-income tax clearance certificate where withholding tax applies. Advisory and tax-structuring fees will trigger heightened AML scrutiny, so the JV must retain full economic-substance documentation.
permissible_fx_hedging_instruments: Onshore deliverable FX forward contracts with a licensed domestic bank and a verified current-account or capital-account underlying exposure
Plain-vanilla FX options and option collars purchased from domestically licensed banks, with no naked speculative positions
Cross-currency interest-rate swaps and FX swaps for long-term JV debt or capital-flow hedging after SAFE registration or approval
Non-deliverable forwards (NDFs) are permitted only outside mainland China and are not an onshore clearing rail unless SAFE grants exceptional onshore approval

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual Enterprise Information Report (Nian Du Bao Gao) filed through the National Enterprise Credit Information Publicity System
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: State Administration for Market Regulation (SAMR) via the National Enterprise Credit Information Publicity System
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Annually from January 1 to June 30, covering the immediately preceding calendar year
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Late filing results in inclusion in the Operating Exception List, public administrative warning, and restriction on government procurement, financing, land approval, import/export, and other activities; continued non-compliance for three consecutive years leads to inclusion in the List of Seriously Illegal and Discredited Enterprises and possible administrative revocation of the business license.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual Corporate Income Tax Reconciliation Return (Qi Suan Qing Jiao) with supporting financial statements
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: State Taxation Administration (STA) / local tax authority
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Annually on or before May 31 of the following calendar year; no standard extension except statutory disaster or special pre-approval
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Underpayment interest accrues at 0.05% per day (simple daily interest) and late-payment penalties may reach 50% of the underpaid amount; persistent failure to file can trigger tax non-normal taxpayer status, invoice restrictions, enforced collection, and criminal exposure for fraud.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Foreign Investment Information Annual Report (including ultimate beneficial owner / actual controller data)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Ministry of Commerce (MOFCOM) via the National Enterprise Credit Information Publicity System (co-submitted with the annual enterprise report)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Annually from January 1 to June 30, with a 30-day post-change reporting obligation for any change in ownership, control, or scope during the year
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Failure to report by the deadline or submitting false or misleading information may attract administrative penalties of up to RMB 500,000, alongside forced correction orders; continued violations may affect foreign exchange, customs, and banking facilitation.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual Statutory Audit Report of the Sino-Foreign Equity Joint Venture
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Shareholders and applicable regulators (tax authorities on request, foreign exchange authorities, and other licensing bodies)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Within the first 6 months of the following fiscal year to align with the annual shareholders' meeting; audited financial statements must be finalized before the annual income tax reconciliation deadline of May 31
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Failure to procure an audit is a breach of the Company Law and the Foreign Investment Law; the company may face regulatory inquiry, reputational damage, denial of foreign exchange repatriation for profits, and administrative fines up to RMB 100,000.

statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.compulsory_audit_thresholds: Under the PRC Company Law, the Foreign Investment Law, and implementing regulations, every company, including all Sino-Foreign Equity Joint Ventures, must prepare annual financial reports and have them independently audited by a registered Chinese CPA firm. There is no turnover, asset, headcount, or shareholder-type exemption for foreign-invested enterprises. The audit mandate is unconditional. Additional compulsory audit layers apply to listed companies, public debt issuers, financial institutions, and entities operating under special licensed sectors (e.g., securities, insurance, banking), as prescribed by the CSRC, PBOC, CBIRC, and MOF regulations.
statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.governing_accounting_framework: China Accounting Standards for Business Enterprises (CAS), which are substantially converged with IFRS; smaller enterprises not meeting full CAS triggering criteria may adopt the Small Enterprise Accounting Standards (SEAS), but foreign-invested enterprises are generally required to apply full CAS. Financial statements must be presented in RMB and follow the PRC chart of accounts, with Chinese-language statutory books.

corporate_registers_and_ubo_annual_confi.ubo_annual_confirmation_protocol: China does not maintain a standalone UBO annual filing under a separate statutory deadline. Instead, Sino-Foreign Equity Joint Ventures must disclose ultimate beneficial ownership and actual controller information in the annual Foreign Investment Information Report, filed concurrently with the annual enterprise information report via the National Enterprise Credit Information Publicity System between January 1 and June 30. Any shareholding transfer, change of actual controller, or change in the ultimate parent that occurs during the year must be reported within 30 days after the change by updating the enterprise registration and the foreign investment information filing through SAMR and MOFCOM. Profit repatriation and foreign exchange remittances are blocked unless the new shareholding and UBO structure has been duly recorded in the official registry.
mandatory_on_site_statutory_registers: Register of Directors, Supervisors and Senior Managers
Minute Book of Shareholder and Board Meetings

recurring_annual_maintenance_budget_usd.registered_office_or_agent_market_range_: USD 250 - USD 800 per year for a registered office address service in major Chinese cities such as Shanghai, Beijing, or Shenzhen; annual local agency compliance service fees are typically additional at USD 500 - USD 1,200
recurring_annual_maintenance_budget_usd.statutory_audit_estimated_fee_usd: USD 800 - USD 2,500 per year for a small-to-medium service enterprise, increasing with transaction volume, number of subsidiaries, cross-border pricing complexity, and engagement of Big Four or tier-1 domestic firms

corporate_income_tax_regime.effective_tax_rate_incentives: High and New Technology Enterprises may elect a reduced 15% rate if certified; Small Low-Profit Enterprises may enjoy reduced rates with taxable income thresholds; certain encouraged industries in Western regions may apply 15%; additional 100% super-deduction for qualifying R&D expenses; no specific patent box regime exists

tax_return_filing_anatomy.form_identifier_and_portal: Form A100000 (Corporate Income Tax Annual Return, A-type) filed via State Taxation Administration electronic tax portal (e-Tax system); quarterly provisional returns filed using Form A200000 via the same portal
tax_return_filing_anatomy.reporting_frequency: Annual final settlement with quarterly provisional filings
tax_return_filing_anatomy.statutory_deadline_rule: Annual return must be filed within 5 months after the calendar year-end (i.e., by May 31); quarterly provisional returns are due within 15 days after the end of each quarter; quarterly instalments are calculated based on actual profits or prior-year method

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Total operating revenue from sales of goods, provision of services, and other business income
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Include only revenue attributable to the Chinese permanent establishment; services rendered abroad to foreign clients by a non-resident without a PE are generally not taxable; beware of transfer pricing adjustments for management fees or service fees charged by foreign head office

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Cost of sales incurred directly in generating the operating revenue
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Write off cost allocations from the foreign head office only where supported by contractual cost recharging and evidence of benefit; require a valid service agreement and proof of actual rendering under tax circular 19/2017; otherwise expense disallowance may apply

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Selling, general and administrative expenses, including intercompany service fees and royalties
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Deductibility of cross-border charges to a non-resident related party requires the charges to satisfy arm's length conditions, be incurred for the Chinese entity's benefit, and be supported by documentation; withholding tax must be met on foreign payables; failing to withhold triggers 50%-3x penalty on the withheld amount

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Operating profit after deduction of operating expenses
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Calculate profit solely from the Chinese accounting books; any tax incentive based on location or industry must be claimed via supplementary schedules and not reduces the operating profit itself

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Non-operating income, including interest, dividends, gains on asset transfers, and other income outside normal operations
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Dividends received from Chinese resident companies are generally tax-exempt after holding 12 months if the investor is a Chinese resident; for non-resident investors, passive income is usually subject to 10% withholding at source when remitted abroad, unless treaty relief applies; report deemed distributions carefully

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Total taxable income after adjustments for tax-exempt income, non-taxable income, and deductible losses carried forward
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Apply annual loss carryforward of up to 5 years; ensure comprehensive loss-offset documentation; non-resident entities with a PE must compute taxable income on a net basis; if no PE, income is separately assessed under withholding rules and should not appear here as it is settled by source payer

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Applicable tax rate, generally 25%, with relief items for preferential rates
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: If a unilateral treaty tie-breaker applies to a dual-resident enterprise, the PE's profits are taxed at the 25% statutory rate minus attributable permanent establishment allowances; treaty restrictions on force-of-attraction should be documented to avoid overreach

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Total tax liability after applying tax credits such as foreign tax credits, and after deducting quarterly instalments already paid
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Foreign tax credit for taxes paid abroad by the PE or its foreign subsidiaries must be computed per-country and may not exceed the Chinese tax due on that foreign-source income; retain official tax receipts and translate them into CNY using the exchange rate prevailing on the payment date

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Net tax payable (refundable) for the year, equal to total liability less instalments and credits
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Any overpayment may be refunded or carried forward; non-resident entities must be aware of anti-abuse rules requiring substantial business activity before claiming treaty benefits on income not effectively connected with the PE; reflect final settlement entries in this line

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Signature by the legal representative, chief accountant, and person in charge of the tax declaration
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: For sino-foreign joint ventures, the foreign director must review and sign the declaration; knowingly signing false statements exposes the director to personal liability for tax evasion under PRC Criminal Law Article 203 and civil restitution under the Company Law

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Attached schedules, including transfer pricing documentation, related party transaction forms, and foreign-held equity information
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Complete Schedule A100000 attachments including Form with affiliate transaction table; mandatory local file disclosure triggers if the controlled transaction exceeds RMB 20 million for tangible goods assignment; RMB 10 million for financial asset transfer; RMB 10 million for intangible property transfer; or RMB 40 million for other related-party transactions; failure to file such schedules may lead to 5% penalty on the transaction amount if the underpayment is discovered

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Tax payment confirmation and final settlement balance after quarterly prepayments
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Ensure quarterly prepayments are made in the same currency as the annual return; late payment interest accrues at 0.05% per day from the due date until payment; criminal liability for fraudulent underpayment exceeding RMB 100,000 and 10% of the tax due may result in imprisonment from 3 to 7 years

tax_return_filing_anatomy.failure_penalties: Late filing of the annual return triggers a civil penalty of RMB 2,000 per month or fraction thereof up to RMB 20,000; intentional concealment or false declaration leading to underpaid tax attracts a 50% to 5 times penalty of the shortfall; criminal evasion arises when the evaded tax exceeds RMB 100,000 and constitutes more than 10% of the payable tax, while failure to file after timely notices or repeated filing of false returns can attract criminal sanctions; daily surcharge of 0.05% of the unpaid tax applies for late payments; travel bans and blacklisting may be imposed for tax debts exceeding RMB 100,000 to stop the legal representative from leaving China

profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.statutory_dividend_wht_rate: 10% on dividends paid by a resident enterprise to a non-resident corporate shareholder, reduced to 5% under the China-Hong Kong DTA, 5% under the China-Singapore DTA subject to 25% shareholding and holding period conditions, or other treaty rates if applicable; no domestic withholding tax applies to dividends paid to Chinese residents
profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.treaty_relief_application_protocol: To claim treaty relief, the non-resident shareholder must obtain a Certificate of Tax Residency (TRC) from the jurisdiction of residence, complete the beneficial ownership self-assessment form, and submit a written application to the Chinese withholding agent at the time of dividend distribution; the withholding agent applies the reduced rate upon approval, but if the tax authority later determines that the shareholder is a conduit or lacks economic substance, the full 10% rate is retroactively recovered; documentation must be held in the form prescribed by the State Taxation Administration Announcement No. 35 of 2015, including a declaration of eligibility for treaty benefits for each dividend payment and a covenant to inform the withholding agent of any change in circumstances
profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.cross_border_royalty_and_interest_wht: Statutory withholding on interest and royalties paid to non-residents is 10%; treaty rates on royalties are typically 10% (China-Hong Kong DTA also 7% for certain royalties) and on interest 10% with certain exemptions for financial institutions; the beneficial owner must file a claim using the same Treaty Relief Application Protocol; for intercompany interest, tax circular 36/2016 imposes a debt-equity ratio restriction of 2:1 for non-financial enterprises, with interest exceeding the ratio not deductible; royalties paid to a related foreign company require evidence of the intellectual property's actual use in China and may face a 15% recharacterization if the transfer pricing is not arm's length

transfer_pricing_and_economic_substance.tp_documentation_threshold_local_currenc: Local File: annual controlled transaction amount of RMB 20 million for tangible goods transfer; RMB 10 million for financial asset transfer; RMB 10 million for intangible property transfer; RMB 40 million for other related party transactions. Master File: RMB 1 billion in annual related party transaction amount or also if the total group revenue exceeds RMB 5.5 billion but below RMB 1 billion in controlled transactions. CbC Report: group consolidated revenue at least RMB 5.5 billion. Thresholds are cumulative for the reporting calendar year
transfer_pricing_and_economic_substance.economic_substance_doctrine: China applies a substance-over-form doctrine via GAAR under Article 47 of the Enterprise Income Tax Law and Circular 118/2009. The Economic Substance Requirements are formalised in the absence of a separate ESR statute but the tax authorities may disregard entities lacking business purpose; for joint ventures engaged in international tax structuring and advisory services, the activity must demonstrate staff, premises, and decision-making in China to support a taxable PE; the Core Income-Generating Activities (CIGA) analysis applies to treaty interpretation and to the attribution of profits to a permanent establishment; the State Taxation Administration may allocate profit to China if the CIGA are performed by the Chinese entity even if legal contracts are with a foreign entity

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Deliberately concealing taxable revenue, booking intercompany management fees without economic substance to shift profit to a low-tax jurisdiction, or preparing false invoices crediting fictitious costs to reduce taxable income below the true amount
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Violation of Article 63 of the PRC Tax Administration and Collection Law; penalty of 50% to 5 times the underpaid tax; criminal prosecution under Article 203 of the Criminal Law; evaded tax exceeding RMB 100,000 and constituting more than 10% of the taxable amount attracts imprisonment of up to 3 years and a fine, or 3 to 7 years if the amount is especially large
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors who issue false tax declarations or instruct falsification of accounts are personally liable for restitution of the evaded tax plus penalties; assets of the director may be attached; travel ban and exit denial are enforced under the Exit-Entry Administration Law if the director has an outstanding tax liability; criminal liability results in direct imprisonment and confiscation of personal property; a criminal conviction disqualifies the director from serving as a manager of any Chinese company for 5 years

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.infraction_category: Shell Company and Abuse of Tax Treaty
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Establishing a Hong Kong or Singapore intermediary with no substantial office, employees, or business activity solely to obtain a lower dividend withholding rate and divert profits from China, while the CIGA remain in mainland China
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: The tax authority invokes the General Anti-Avoidance Rules (Article 47 of Enterprise Income Tax Law) to recharacterize the intermediary and impose the full 10% withholding; an adjustment adds back the avoided tax and a penalty of 50% to 3 times the avoided tax; a 10.5% interest surcharge for a special tax investigation may be applied under Measures for Special Tax Adjustments; the intermediary may be ordered to deregister and its perceived dividend treated as taxable income in China
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors of the Chinese joint venture who sign the distribution to the tax haven entity without treaty clearance shall be jointly and severally liable for the underpaid tax; their personal bank accounts, real estate, and equity holdings may be frozen under the Tax Collection Law; travel bans apply to foreign directors with Chinese tax liabilities; if the transfer pricing adjustment leads to an unfiled amended return, criminal negligence charges may be brought under Article 201 of the Criminal Law for failing to declare taxable income

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Using the advisory services entity to recycle undocumented fees through round-tripping transactions, disguising a loan as equity to extract tax-free repatriation, or accepting cash without proper invoicing thus creating an unrecorded slush fund laundered through the corporate bank account
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Violation of Anti-Money Laundering Law Articles 16 and 32; administrative fine of RMB 500,000 to RMB 5 million for the company, with penalties against the responsible persons of RMB 50,000 to RMB 500,000; if the concealment of proceeds exceeds RMB 5 million, criminal liability arises under Article 191 of the Criminal Law (money laundering), resulting in imprisonment of 5 to 10 years and a fine; additionally the tax authority imposes a penalty equal to 50% to 5 times the evaded tax measured on the unreported revenue
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors who approve fund transfers to tax havens knowing that the underlying transaction is fictitious are treated as accomplices; they are subject to asset forfeiture and restitution to the company for losses; a court may pierce the corporate veil under Article 20 of the Company Law if the corporate form is misused to evade tax, making directors personally accountable for all company tax debts and criminal fines; blacklisting by the State Taxation Administration may result a prohibition on exiting China and on starting or investing in any new Chinese company for a mandatory period of 5 years
